newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy govt has no problem with Stet/Telecom merger.
newsitem.headline: Italy govt has no problem with Stet/Telecom merger.

text.p: Italian Posts and Telecommunications minister Antonio Maccanico said there were no problems within the government over the proposed merger between phone operator Telecom Italia and its parent Stet.

Details of the two companies' merger are expected to be revealed this month but confusion has arisen recently with some government officials proposing Telecom Italia should absorb Stet and some saying it should be the reverse.
"There are no problems within the government" over the method of the merger, Maccanico told reporters attending a conference.
He also said that a decision was imminent on the definition of rules authorising cordless phones using the Digital European Cordless Telephony (DECT) standard.

Referring to the creation of a telecoms sector watchdog authority, a necessary step before Stet's privatisation due this year, Maccanico said the government aimed to approve measures setting it up by March.
